children: Thailand's economy is expected to grow by 2.1% to 2.5% this year, a leading business group said on Wednesday, raising its outlook from an earlier forecast of 1.6% to 2.0% growth.
Exports, a key driver of Thai growth, are expected to rise 12% to 16%, up from a previously projected rise of 8% to 10%, the Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking said.
Southeast Asia's second-largest economy expanded 2.4% last year.
